note: What packages can rely on beside the SDK's names: the pipelines (name and payload type), the services (ABI ids), the contributes keys (their entry schemas and the when keys), the mount ctx, and the SDK names that imply a grant. Each lock records it as `sections` (SDK 1.2.0, slice U1). scripts/sdk-surface.mjs diffs it: adding an entry is a minor change, removing or retyping one is a major change. The static `uses` check reads the same file.

files.openWith.payload: { openers: FileOpener[]; file: { name: string; ext: string; mediaType: string } }

notification.post.payload: { notification: { title: string; body: string; kind: string } }

commands.entry: { id: string; title: string; scope: 'global' | 'app' | `target:${string}`; run: { action: 'openApp' | 'openFile' | 'copyText' | 'setTheme' | 'toast' } | { handler: true }; when?: string }

keybindings.entry: { key: string; command: string; when?: string }

links.entry: { app: string; params: { name: string; required?: boolean; context?: string }[]; launch?: { windowTitle?: string; requireAny?: string[]; context?: Record<string, string | number | boolean> } }
